==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I went to the village skatepark to skateboard around. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Elven Village Skatepark resembles a skatepark made up of ramps and rails made of wood and white stone.)
A violent were-beagle started chasing and attacking me. (The Pink Were-Beagle resembles a large, muscular, pink, humanoid beagle wearing a blue jumpsuit and black boots.)
I escaped him by using geomancy to make an armor suit of black stone that I used to fly away. (My Geo-Man suit resembles a sleek, form fitting, armored suit made of black stone tiles.)
